senses.gloss:
(I)--funerary mound; found in अयोध्या; its trees as frequented by पिशाचस्;
1: भा. IX. ११. २७; Br. III. 7. ४१५; Vi. III. १२. १३.
a householder to avoid Caitya.
2: Vi. III. ११. १२२.
(II)--a Marut of the first गण. Br. III. 5. ९२. [page१-612+ २९]
(I)--one of the nine sons of स्वारोचिष-Manu. Br. II. ३६. १९; Vi. III. 1. १२.
(II)--a Paulastya and a sage of the तामस Manvantara. Br. II. ३६. ४८.
--the wife of ज्यामघ; gave birth to Vidarbha. M. ४४. ३२ and ३६.
--a मन्वन्तरादि for श्राद्ध, and good for व्रतस् like the मदनद्वादशि; best for military expedition. M. 7. १०: १७. 6: ५४. 8; ५६. 3; ६०. ३३; २४०. 5.

(I)--a pleasure garden of Devas and Indra to which went Kardama and देवहूति.
1: भा. III. २३. ४०; V. १६. १४; IX. १४. २४; M. २७. 4; Vi. IV. 6. ४८.
In the Candra- prabha hill. Here उर्वशी met Aila.
2: Br. II. १८. 7; III. 7. १०२; ६६. 6.
In the Mandara hill;
3: M. ८३. ३१; १२१. 8; १३१. ४८.
in the east
4: वा. ३६. ११; ४२. १५; ४७. 6; ६९. १३७; ९१. 6. Vi. II. 2. २५.
of इलावृत.
(II)--acted as calf when the Gandharvas and Apsaras milked the earth. M. १०. २४.

(also बिन्दुमती)--the daughter of शश- bindu and wife of मान्धात; had १०,000 younger brothers; righteous, fair and chaste; mother of three sons Purukutsu, अम्बरिष and Mucukunda. Br. III. ६३. ७०; वा. ८८. ७०-2. [page१-613+ ३६]
--a sage of the तामस epoch. Vi. III. 1. १८.
